name: VaultDoor
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A square chunky stone wall panel with a big round hole in the middle, framed by a thick round metal ring studded with eight big round rivets, and a small rectangular plate under the ring. The hole is empty. Front view, flat back, single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Light warm grey stone blocks, steel-blue metal ring with shiny gold rivets, navy plate with a gold border. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: Goes in the Vault end house doorway (Config.Map.DoorSize 8 x 12): HouseKit.placeVaultDoor puts the Frame's centre half its height above the doorway floor, front -Z. Frame = stone wall + ring (Meshy, yaw 180 to face -Z), Door = the clock-face disc (component VaultDoorFace) that Run swings on its left edge. Dial and PricePlate are helper parts.
